task: Export proposal pitch deck to PowerPoint (.pptx), implement interactive slide preview with next/previous navigation, keyboard support, full-screen rehearsal, and eliminate visual bugs & team label redundancy
rootCausesIdentified: Pitch Deck was a static single slide card without navigation controls, limiting proponents to only seeing Slide 1 before defense.
No PowerPoint (.pptx) export capability existed; only PDF export was implemented.
Proponent attribution in pitch deck preview rendered 'Team Team Gamma' due to prepending 'Team ' to an already prefixed team name in team?.name.
Docker client container 'cms-client' runs the Vite dev server with isolated node_modules, requiring pptxgenjs installation both on host and inside the container.

modifications.summary: Built comprehensive, institutional 8-slide PowerPoint (.pptx) presentation generator using pptxgenjs styled in BukSU Institutional branding (Navy #0A3254, Academic Gold #E5A823, Slate body #334155) with 16:9 widescreen layout.

Implemented interactive 8-slide deck carousel with Previous/Next buttons, active indicator pill tracking (1-8), keyboard shortcuts (ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Escape), Fullscreen rehearsal modal, dedicated PowerPoint Export button with loading spinner, and cleanTeamName regex sanitizer preventing 'Team Team' prefix duplication.
Added unit test for pitch deck slide carousel, pptx export trigger, team name sanitization, next/previous slide cycling, and fullscreen modal interaction. Verified 11/11 tests passing.

Executed Playwright visual audit across light and dark modes, desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844), validating slide transitions, button enabled/disabled states, 16:9 aspect ratio, and zero visual clipping.

verification.visualAudit: scratch/test_visual.mjs (desktop dark/light, mobile dark/light, fullscreen, slide transitions 100% verified)

lessonsLearned: When Vite dev server runs inside Docker ('cms-client'), new npm packages must be installed both on the host and inside the container ('docker exec cms-client npm install ...') with a container restart to prevent Vite overlay import errors.

Always sanitize entity names that might contain semantic prefix redundancy (e.g. team.name 'Team Gamma' displayed as 'Team ' + team.name -> 'Team Team Gamma') using a clean memo: name.replace(/^Team\s+/i, '').

For slide presentations inside web applications, maintaining a strict 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio (aspect-video) ensures visual fidelity and consistency between the web preview and generated PPTX/PDF files.
